name: fx-trading-system/research
purpose: Agent-facing FX quant research knowledge base (notes-first, OA PDFs secondary)
write_boundary: research/ only; rest of repo read-only for research agents unless user says otherwise
rules: Read notes before PDFs; never bulk-load the PDF tree into context (post-purge ~341 files)
Always check MISLABEL_LOG / PDF first page title before citing a file path
cost_incomplete => no formal net PnL claims
No approved trading strategy as of library snapshot
New factor candidates require WP9 charter; do not expand search registry from reading alone
PDF discovery: filter agent/pdf_index.jsonl then abstract_file; never dump all abstracts
PDF policy: index-first; extract on demand only (one PDF); do not bulk-write study-L3 notes for all PDFs

do_not: 用政策利率声称真实 carry 复制
用 mid 回测写净收益
用 F_hat 顶替可交易 forward
忽略搜索账本中已有形成期网格
把 OOS 翻号当可交易
把 current-vintage REER 当 strict PIT 方向 alpha
用 finalists 代替完整 trial count
用 1h bar 声称验证 5 秒边界
用未来平仓 spread 过滤
无 consensus 时构造方向 surprise
spot 22d 收益冒充 forward excess
公开 1y financing 外推 2016-2025 净收益
CFTC current archive 当 as-published vintage
把探索结果写成可交易
用 CFTC 或 tick count 冒充 signed OF
